newsitem.title: USA: Weis Markets to start $120 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: Weis Markets to start $120 mln expansion.

text.p: Weis Markets said Wednesday it would invest $120 million over the next 18 months for an expansion program, which includes the construction of 11 superstores and the remodeling of 20 others.
Over the past two years, Weis Markets has built 19 superstores and remodeled nineteen others.

"Through 1997 and beyond, we will make a significant investment in our company's future by investing $120 million in our expansion," said Weis Chairman Robert Weis. "This is a tremendous investment in our company's future. No other supermarket company our size is investing as much in its store base as Weis Markets is."
